prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, timeline and whether you need full-service work or a specific specialty (SEO, paid media, content, B2B marketing, e‑commerce, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. To get you started, here’s a practical way to choose and what to ask for.

How to choose the best agency for you
- Define goals and KPIs first: e.g., increase qualified leads by X, cut cost-per-acquisition to Y, grow organic traffic by Z%, or boost online sales by X%.
- Determine scope and channel priorities: SEO, paid search (PPC), social ads, content, email, web development, analytics, or an integrated program.
- Set your budget and timeline (monthly retainer, project budget, or performance fees).
- Decide whether you want a local agency (advantages: face-to-face, local market knowledge) or a niche/specialist that might be remote.

What to look for in proposals and agencies
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (not just vanity metrics).
- Industry experience and examples of similar clients.
- Clear scope, deliverables, timelines, and reporting cadence.
- Attribution and analytics plan (how they will track results).
- Team make-up and who will actually do the work.
- References and contactable client examples.
- Pricing model and contract terms (notice period, KPIs tied to fees if any).

Questions to ask during vetting
- What specific outcomes did you achieve for clients like us? (Ask for numbers.)
- Who would be on our account and what are their roles?
- How do you measure and report ROI?
- Which tools do you use (analytics, ad platforms, automation)?
- Can you show a 90–180 day plan for our first quarter together?
- What are typical ramp-up times and minimum retainer?

Red flags
- No measurable case studies or only vague “brand awareness” statements.
- Promises of guaranteed rankings or unrealistically fast results.
- Lack of transparent reporting or unwillingness to share references.

If you want agency names
Tell me:
- Your industry (B2B, healthcare, e‑commerce, nonprofit, etc.)
- Monthly budget or annual marketing budget
- Main goal (lead gen, sales, awareness, recruitment)
- Whether local (St. Louis) presence is important

I’ll shortlist 3–5 agencies in St. Louis (or nearby) tailored to your needs and why each might fit. Would you like me to do that?
